info.name: FarmerBD Buyer Role Tests
info.description: Buyer role verification. Run folders 0 to 7 in order. In the Collection Runner set Delay to 800 ms (the API allows 100 requests per minute).

item.name: 0. Setup (run first)
item.description: Creates 2 farmers, 2 buyers and 5 products with unique emails. Run this folder first. Tokens and ids are saved as collection variables.

exec: pm.test("Role is BUYER", function () { pm.expect(json.role || (json.user && json.user.role)).to.eql("BUYER"); });

item.name: PATCH phone used by another user -> 409

exec: pm.test("First address is default", function () { pm.expect(json.isDefault).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Second address is not default", function () { pm.expect(json.isDefault).to.eql(false); });
pm.test("2 addresses, default first", function () { pm.expect(json.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(json[0].isDefault).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Our published products are listed", function () { pm.expect(json.data.length).to.eql(4); pm.expect(json.meta.total).to.eql(4); });
pm.test("Draft product hidden", function () { const ids = json.data.map(p => p.id); pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("prodX")); });
pm.test("2 per page, 2 pages", function () { pm.expect(json.data.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(json.meta.totalPages).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("Prices ascending", function () { const p = json.data.map(x => x.pricePerUnit); pm.expect(p).to.eql([...p].sort((a, b) => a - b)); });
pm.test("Only products A and B", function () { pm.expect(json.data.length).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("Only Farmer One products", function () { pm.expect(json.data.length).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("Has name and stock", function () { pm.expect(json.name).to.include("Product A"); pm.expect(json.availableQuantity).to.eql(100); });
